distribution.narrative: Wang, Beaver & Hulcr (2017) described this species from Ilan County, Taiwan (Yuanshan, Fushan Research Center). Originally reported under Corthylini, its genus was transferred to Dryocoetini by Johnson et al. (2023).

host_note: Reported from fallen logs of Lithocarpus hancei in Taiwan (Wang et al., 2017).
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Urocorthylus fanii Wang, Beaver & Hulcr, 2017. Original description 2017, current tribal placement Dryocoetini following Johnson et al. (2023).

taxonomic_history.name: Urocorthylus fanii
taxonomic_history.note: Original description 2017, current tribal placement Dryocoetini following Johnson et al. (2023).

nomenclature_note: Recommended Chinese name: 范氏密毛小蠹 (newly proposed in the 2026 China checklist; curator-approved).
